propositions: Size metrics are currently hardcoded to scan src/rebar and read from .github/module-size-limit.txt, yielding fabricated zeros for non-Python clients instead of Unavailable.

Size metrics must be migrated onto the scc LOC analyzer and [code_health] config, with compute adapted via _analyzer_spec to call scc_loc.analyze and pass (loc, size_cap, size_near_fraction) to sizing functions.

module_size_distribution and oversized_module_count functions must handle the loc payload and size_cap/size_near_fraction parameters, returning None (Unavailable) when size_cap is None and computing over_cap_count and near_cap_count when configured.
The hardcoded _LIMIT_FILE, _read_cap, src/rebar rglob, and cap_change_events registration must be removed from git_metrics.py and the oversized_module_count seed stub removed from registry.py.
Context in _commands/metrics.py must be extended to carry scan_roots, size_cap, and size_near_fraction from [code_health] config.
Analyzer-derived specs must carry provenance source='structural', lens='code_health', and accruing_since='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'.
